# performance

Use when the user asks for performance work.

## Workflow
1. Define a measurable baseline and performance budget.
2. Profile before modifying.
3. Identify bottlenecks in CPU, rendering, queries, memory and I/O.
4. Make minimal changes, benchmark after, and inspect regressions or caching invalidation.

## Verification
State which checks were executed, what passed, and what could not be verified. Favor existing project conventions. Use local resources; do not require network access merely to read this skill.
